proposals.evidence: Turner’s asmad article explicitly lists Maithili, Bhojpuri, Awadhi and Hindi ham as the direct and oblique continuation of the plural stem. Platts separately attests the same pronoun’s frequent singular “I” use, resolving the apparent number mismatch in these elicited responses. The link is to asmad, not aham or the homonymous Persian ham prefix; longer hāmra/hame forms are excluded.
